title: Month-of-year conditioned number inclusion
hypothesis: Month-of-year-conditioned historical number inclusion rates may add predictive information beyond global-frequency and exact uniform 5-of-40 baselines.

models.M0: Exact uniform 5-of-40 subset distribution; each number inclusion probability 0.125.

walk_forward.update_rule: score each target before adding its draw to global or month-of-year counts

selection.criterion: minimum Validation mean joint subset log-loss

metrics: mean marginal inclusion Brier across 40 numbers

inference.method: one-sided paired block sign-flip for improvement

limitations: Historical Blind OOS is not a virgin holdout after prior SONAR exploration.
Historical rankings/frequencies are reconstructed, not contemporaneously frozen forecasts.
Holm correction covers the four Q118 endpoints only, not the full Q00-Q118 research family.
The month-of-year model is a research probability model, not the production SONAR scorer.
guardrails: No Q60 record or existing freeze changes.
